sample_note: Illustrative data for building the web app. Based on seeded variant V13 (cap set to the maximum). Real runs will differ in numbers and wording.

rules.text: Only investors with a valid KYC claim from a trusted issuer may receive tokens.
At least one KYC claim topic must be required.
Investors registered in a restricted country (408) may not receive tokens.
No investor may hold more than 1000 tokens.
The holding-limit module's balance records must match the real token balances.

findings.title: Holding limit can be exceeded: the cap is not enforced
findings.policy_violated: No investor may hold more than 1000 tokens.
findings.explanation: The holding-limit module is bound, but its cap was set to the largest possible number, so it never blocks anything. Bob received 1200 tokens, which is above the 1000 limit in your policy.
findings.suggested_fix: Set the cap to the intended number through ModularCompliance.callModuleFunction (setMaxBalance(1000)). Check the token's decimals when you write the number.
